filtration.section.title: The path to pure perfection
filtration.section.subtitle: Our 6-stage water filtration
filtration.section.lead: Before reaching the lab and being bottled, every drop of Aqua Viva water passes through a precise six-stage purification system.
filtration.phase.label: Stage
filtration.phase1.title: Pharmaceutical micron filter
filtration.phase1.body: A pharmaceutical-grade micron filter that captures even the most microscopic residual elements.
filtration.phase2.title: Activated carbon
filtration.phase2.body: Eliminates organic contaminants, absorbs residual chlorine, and refines the taste and aroma of the water.
filtration.phase3.title: Ion exchange resin
filtration.phase3.body: Specialized resin that selectively swaps hardness ions and trace heavy metals for harmless ones, softening the water and fine-tuning its mineral balance.
filtration.phase4.title: Reverse osmosis
filtration.phase4.body: High-pressure filtration that fully removes excess minerals, salts, impurities, and trace heavy elements.
filtration.phase5.title: Ultraviolet (UV) light
filtration.phase5.body: Powerful UV disinfection that destroys 99.99% of microorganisms and bacteria without altering the composition of the water.
filtration.phase6.title: Ozonation
filtration.phase6.body: Ozone infusion delivers fully natural sterilization - lasting freshness and microbiological safety in every bottle.

about.page.title: About - SJI Group
about.page.description: SJI Group Ltd - the Bulgarian company behind Aqua Viva and Santos. Over two decades of expertise bottling premium water and refreshing drinks.
about.hero.title: Reliability, built on principles
about.hero.subtitle: Since 2000 we have been crafting beverages you can rely on - with engineering precision, scientific control, and a quiet dedication to quality.
about.story.title: A family company. Industrial precision.
about.story.lead: SJI Group Ltd is a Bulgarian company that has been turning pure water into a trusted product for more than two decades.
about.story.body1: We started in 2000 - with a small team, a clear purpose, and the conviction that every bottle has to earn the trust of the person who opens it. Over the years we invested in modern filtration systems, in independent lab control, and in people who take quality personally.
about.story.body2: In 2012 we introduced Aqua Viva - the brand that brought together our highest standards for purity, taste, and consistency. It quickly became the choice of thousands of families, offices, and partners.
about.story.body3: Today SJI Group is no longer just a manufacturer - it is a long-term partner for distributors, restaurants, hospitals, schools, and industrial clients who expect transparency, guaranteed availability, and a product that never lets them down.
about.story.pull: Quality is not an ambition. It is a habit - repeated every day, every batch, every bottle.
about.timeline.2000.title: Founded
about.timeline.2000.body: We begin operations with a focus on bottling high-quality beverages.
about.timeline.2012.title: Aqua Viva
about.timeline.2012.body: We launch our own brand of table water - a symbol of clarity and consistency.
about.timeline.today.label: Today
about.timeline.today.title: A trusted partner
about.timeline.today.body: We supply families, offices, restaurants, and industry across the country.
about.science.title: Precision, proven in the lab
about.science.intro: Before it reaches the bottle, every batch of water is fully analyzed - not as a formality, but as a responsibility. The tests are run by independent, accredited laboratories every single month.
about.science.quote: We don't trust words - we trust results. So we verify them every single month.
about.science.stat1.label: Elements analyzed
about.science.stat1.body: Microbiology, heavy metals, mineral composition, organic compounds - all traceable in writing.
about.science.stat2.label: Independent tests per year
about.science.stat2.body: External accredited laboratories run a complete analysis every month, without exception.
about.science.stat3.label: Internal monitoring
about.science.stat3.body: Continuous quality control at every stage - from source to sealed bottle.
about.filtration.title: Six stages to perfect clarity
about.filtration.intro: Every stage has its precise role. Together they form a system where nothing is left to chance - from the first mechanical filter to the final ozonation.
about.monitoring.title: Sensors that never blink
about.monitoring.lead: Quality is not a state - it is a process. Every line is equipped with sensors that run continuously and automation that reacts in fractions of a second.
about.monitoring.body: Pressure, flow, turbidity, conductivity, temperature, ozone level - every parameter is tracked and recorded in real time. At the slightest deviation the system stops the line automatically, before a single bottle leaves it.
about.monitoring.stat.label: Microbiological safety
about.monitoring.feature1.title: Sensors across the line
about.monitoring.feature1.body: Dozens of measurement points control flow, quality, and sterility.
about.monitoring.feature2.title: Automatic response
about.monitoring.feature2.body: Algorithms halt the process at the first deviation - before anyone notices.
about.monitoring.feature3.title: A transparent record
about.monitoring.feature3.body: Every batch has a full digital history - from filling to sealing.
about.closing.title: Completely pure and light.
about.closing.body: That is everything we promise. And everything we deliver every day - quietly, precisely, consistently.
about.euProject.title: Co-financed by the European Union
about.euProject.subtitle: European project
about.euProject.body: SJI GROUP Ltd, as the beneficiary under administrative contract No. BG16RFPR001-1.004-0946-C01, is implementing a project under the 'Competitiveness and Innovation in Enterprises 2021–2027' programme, co-financed by the European Union.
